svg.title: XVF3800 pin map by function
svg.desc: Top view of the 60-pin QFN with every pin coloured by function and labelled with its signal and its use on the MindSpeak rev 1 board.
svg.text: Signal name (official XMOS pinout), then its use on MindSpeak rev 1. Updated 2026-11-11.
* also driven by the ESP32 (SPI2) through the four TS5A3166 switches when the PROG switch SW701 is on.
Pins 59, 60, 1 are boot straps (internal pull-downs → QSPI boot). No SPI-slave boot. TP = test pad.
Pin 43 drives an SN74LVC1G125 buffer, then 100 Ω per mic. Pins 56/58 = status LED red/green (also read by ESP32 GPIO15/16); blue unused.
